MMRDA reports six currently operational Line 2B stations. All six supplied KML station placemarks are within 167 m of the official ArcGIS route feature and map to the current operator sequence and DPR entries. The ArcGIS station point for Mankhurd is 770 m from its KML marker; Chembur is 210 m from its ArcGIS point. The six-stop CTM slice is now transcribed, while database CTM materialization, as-built P1, and the remaining 14 stations remain open.

MoHUA/Esri ArcGIS candidate features exist for several non-operational lines, but station-level crosswalks and route geometry have not been validated. Line 4/4A is combined in one feature; Line 7A has no dedicated route feature.

Four operational Phase I Line 9 points are source-verified from ArcGIS; the full eight-station corridor crosswalk and distinct CTM route entities are not complete. Dahisar East is shared with the existing Line 2A/7 station complex.

The official ArcGIS Green feature 58 combines Lines 4 and 4A. Establish the Kasarvadavali/Gowniwada boundary and validate each line's own length and station sequence before splitting or promoting geometry.
